verdict.rationale: A public online filing portal could plausibly publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows the Guichet unique offers either: the INPI pages are human-facing procedural guides. The probes cover other state hosts (the annuaire-entreprises robots.txt and the recherche-entreprises API), not llms.txt or agent docs for this product.
